:::{#def-half-space-inequality}
#### Half-space

Let $\vecf{a} \in \reals^p$ be a nonzero vector and $c$ a real number.
The set $\cb{\vx \in \reals^p : \dprod{\vecf{a}}{\vx} \ge c}$ is a (closed) **half-space**:
the points on one side of the boundary $\cb{\vx : \dprod{\vecf{a}}{\vx} = c}$, together with the boundary.
In $\reals^2$, a half-space is called a **half-plane**.

:::
